svg.aria-label: Hop by hop path from a Sydney demo host to an Auckland demo host: spoke route table, Transit Gateway inspection route table, Sydney firewall, TGW peering, then Auckland firewall and delivery
svg.font-family: Manrope, Open Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.title: Traffic path after Allow: double-inspect on both hubs
svg.desc: The Sydney column reads downward: the demo host sends to its spoke VPC route table, which sends the Auckland dev CIDR to the Transit Gateway attachment. On the Transit Gateway the spoke association is the inspection route table; egress follows 0.0.0.0/0 through the Sydney firewall endpoint, then leaves via TGW peering. Traffic crosses peering at the bottom, then the Auckland column reads upward: the peer association is the inspection route table, the Auckland firewall endpoint inspects again, the no-inspection route table sends the local spoke CIDR to the spoke attachment, and the spoke route table delivers to the Auckland demo host.
